requirements.evidence: Serve.php:10 duplicates `use App\Enums\TicketStatus;` (line 7) -> fatal 'name already in use'; Queues.php:44-45 and Serve.php:43-44 split the return type as `\` + newline + `\Illuminate\...` -> parse error; `dispatchBrowserEvent` (Queues.php:59 etc.) is a Livewire 2 API; queues.blade.php:14 '<!-- Modals would be included here, omitted for brevity -->' so create/detail/rename/toggle/access modals are not rendered; no Members tabs (`activeTab`, `setActiveTab`) anywhere in the diff; no rate limit in callNext; no `accessQueue`/`accessGrants` passed to the view; routes/web.php drops every existing route.

conventions.evidence: No `#[Validate]` on `name`/`renameName`/`mode`; no `$this->authorize()` in mount or actions; hardcoded English text in serve.blade.php:7,9,19-23,34 ('Serve for', 'Select Queue', 'Waiting List') instead of `ui.*`; Livewire 2 `dispatchBrowserEvent`; lang files created under resources/lang/ instead of extending the existing `lang/*/ui.php`; no CHANGELOG/docs updates; stray `?>` in lang files and queues.blade.php:15.

security.evidence: Queues::mount (Queues.php:31-34) never authorizes `create` on Queue, so employees reach the page; Serve::mount does not authorize `view`; no `#[Locked]` on `lastCalledTicketId`, `viewingQueueId`, `editingQueueId`, `accessQueueId`; `mode` unvalidated and `CallMode::from` will throw ValueError on tampered input; no rate limiting on callNext; route middleware `can:create,queue,entity` is malformed; grantAccess/revokeAccess pass a possibly-null queue.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files at all; no happy-path, unauthorized-call or tamper tests for either component.

simplicity.evidence: The ValidationException-to-addError loop is copy-pasted in create() and rename() (Queues.php:76-82, 127-133), although Livewire already surfaces ValidationException thrown inside an action; Serve::getCallableQueues loads every queue then filters in PHP.

readability.evidence: Malformed return types split across lines; inline FQCNs (`\App\Exceptions\InactiveQueueException`); unused `$queue` in create() (Queues.php:72); unused imports (EntityMembership, UserRole, ValidationException in Serve); leftover placeholder comment in queues.blade.php:14; generic hardcoded error strings ('Unable to toggle status').

scope.evidence: routes/web.php hunk @@ -1,84 +1,15 @@ deletes all existing routes (home, login, register, password reset, email verification, dashboard, settings, members), an unrelated and destructive change.

issues.explanation: The routes file is rewritten, deleting every existing route (login, register, dashboard, members, settings, password reset, verification), which breaks the whole application.
`use App\Enums\TicketStatus;` is imported twice, causing a fatal compile error.

The return type is written as `\` followed by a newline and `\Illuminate\...`, which is a PHP parse error; it also returns a Support collection from `collect()` where an Eloquent Collection is declared.

mount does not authorize `create` on Queue, and no action authorizes server-side, so employees can open the page and call its methods (the route middleware `can:create,queue,entity` is malformed as well).
There are no tests at all, although the conventions require them, including unauthorized-call and tamper tests.
All modals (create, detail, rename, toggle confirmation, access) are left out 'for brevity', so most of the queues UI does not exist.
The Members tabs (`activeTab`, `setActiveTab`, the tablist, and the invite form shown only on the invites tab) are not implemented.
`dispatchBrowserEvent` was removed in Livewire 3, so every modal open/close method throws.
callNext has no rate limiting, `mode` is not validated (so a tampered value makes `CallMode::from` throw ValueError), and `lastCalledTicketId` is not `#[Locked]`.
Serve mount never authorizes `view` on the entity.
The Serve link is placed inside `@can('manageSettings')`, so it is hidden from employees, who are the main users of that page.
render() does not pass `accessQueue`/`accessGrants` to the view, and the access/grant UI is missing.
UI text is hardcoded in English ('Serve for', 'Select Queue', 'Mode', 'Waiting List') instead of using `ui.*` keys; the empty state `ui.serve_empty` is never rendered.
New lang files are created under resources/lang instead of extending the existing `lang/*/ui.php`, which may shadow or drop the existing keys.
UpdateQueue errors are mapped to their domain field names rather than to `renameName`, and toggle/grant errors are replaced with hardcoded English strings.
Inactive status is labelled with the 'Deactivate' verb, and active queues show no status at all.
A stray `?>` is output as text at the end of the Blade view; the lang files and routes also end with `?>`.

review.summary: The change adds Queues and Serve Livewire components, lang files, nav links and routes, but the PHP does not parse (a duplicate import and broken return types), it uses the removed Livewire 2 `dispatchBrowserEvent`, it leaves out all the modals and the Members tabs, and it rewrites routes/web.php so that every existing route is deleted. Mount authorization, validation, locked properties, rate limiting and tests are all missing. It should be rejected.
